text_block_list.text:
Cesario didn't seem to be feeling well,
so I brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for accompanying me.
I'll rest for a little while...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"The stage is set――and yet,
Cesario... is this truly your script?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"My daughter. My treasure! Concealing your identity
and heading to another country... How could I ever permit such a thing!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: "That's right, dear sister. There's no need to lie to yourself just to go to that person...!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text: ...You're next, Cesario-chan!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Huh? Ah—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
(...What is written in the script are lines
to tearfully sing of cherishing a tragic end in love,
proclaiming it as one's true desire.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (Something doesn't feel right... I really don't want to say it.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Rather than letting it end in tragedy,
there must surely be another path for me...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: —Then I'll just have to rewrite it!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"I want to prove it. That no love goes unrewarded,
and no heartfelt feeling is in vain."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I am—going forward! To defy this fate! Even if you all try to stop me! With all my heart and soul!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...I see. Your feelings have truly reached me,
my daughter...! You'll be just fine, I know it!"

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
"Big sister...!
*sniffle* I'll be cheering for you...!"

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
""...Thank you very much.
I will walk my own path, and—""

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "I will surely make my way to you, my beloved."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I had a feeling you would do just that.
...You deserve immense applause."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Demonstrating one's convictions and forging a path forward.
I thought a development like that wouldn't be half bad.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Besides, I... prefer comedies over tragedies♪

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: (—Ah. The curtain has fallen.)

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Still... that feels so refreshing.
Now I can really give it my all in training!
